scientific_integrity: All-dimensional formulas and unique minimizer established by a self-contained algebraic proof. Exact symbolic identities and rational root enclosure replayed; numerical random trials only corroborate them. No independent external mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Four ordered real nodes, endpoints fixed at the ends of the closed interval, exact unweighted full-interval variation and arbitrary real sample data. No statement about unconstrained endpoint locations, higher degrees, approximation convergence or other norms. Historical priority may be affected by unindexed equivalent finite-node variation analyses.
title: Unique globally variation-optimal four-node cubic interpolation with fixed endpoints
